from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-fc9280a8.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    left_width = width // 2
    border = grid[0][0]
    separators = [r for r in range(height) if all(v == border for v in grid[r][:left_width])]
    output = [row[:left_width] for row in grid]
    panels = []
    for top, bottom in zip(separators, separators[1:]):
        rows = range(top + 1, bottom)
        reference = tuple(tuple(grid[r][c] == 0 for c in range(1, left_width - 1)) for r in rows)
        shape = tuple(tuple(grid[r][c] != 0 for c in range(left_width + 1, left_width + 1 + left_width - 2)) for r in rows)
        colors = {grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in range(left_width + 1, left_width + 1 + left_width - 2) if grid[r][c] != 0}
        panels.append((top, bottom, reference, shape, colors))
    objects = [(shape, next(iter(colors))) for _, _, _, shape, colors in panels if len(colors) == 1]
    for top, bottom, reference, _, _ in panels:
        color = next((color for shape, color in objects if shape == reference), None)
        if color is not None:
            for ri, r in enumerate(range(top + 1, bottom)):
                for ci, c in enumerate(range(1, left_width - 1)):
                    if reference[ri][ci]:
                        output[r][c] = color
    return output
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
